title: Checkpoint file
description: specs/<feature>/.flow/checkpoints/<name>.json. Only flow.mjs add and flow.mjs answer write it. A row with no answer is open. An open row with no affects holds the phase in blocks; an open row with affects makes only the tasks that name those ids wait.

blocks.description: The phase id the checkpoint holds: plan for product, implement for design.

audience.description: Who answers: po, client, plan-authors, or the owner a constitution names.

recommended.description: The answer the draft is written on until the row is answered.

phase.description: The phase that applies the answer to its artifact. An answer that differs from the one the artifact was drafted on sends this phase back, then each later one.

affects.description: Criterion or other ids that wait for the answer. Empty means the whole checkpoint waits.

by.description: Who decided: the person, or the client when relayed.

channel.description: How the answer came: session, relayed, notes, jira, or another the host names.

interim.description: The PO answered for now; the hold lifts and the row stays open for the client.

relayed_by.description: The person who passed on an answer someone else gave.

source.description: The notes file or message the answer came from.

replaced.description: The reason a final answer was replaced.
